title: Which 2D operation loses the canvas
blurb: Seventeen trials, each doing one thing that the pages which lost their canvases on a phone have in common. Each starts on a press. The result of every trial is stored before and after it runs, so a tab that dies names the trial that was running.
question: Which single 2D canvas operation, run alone, loses the canvas or the tab on a phone?
result: In Chromium 157 with software rendering no trial loses a canvas. The page is built to be run on the phone, where the losses were reported.
